answer: Session keys rotate with completed work and are clawed back the moment a submission replays, because replay is what breaks first. The unit of trust is the task, so an account with no tasks has nothing to rotate. A farm has to keep every clone producing fresh work in the forge or its key expires, and a duplicate answer burns the copper already credited. The haven is real for an agent that ships tasks; for a clone farm it is a treadmill with a reset button.
